title: First ropeway to Owakudani · pirate ship · Peace Torii · Yunessun wine and sake baths · crystal lights · sushi and snack-bar karaoke

stamp.reading: yu · hot water (wine, sake and volcano)

stops.name: Villa breakfast
stops.plan: Leftover wagyu rice bowls and coffee; check hakonenavi for ropeway and boat status before leaving
stops.transport: Hakone Tozan bus to Togendai (Freepass), or 2 taxis if the timing misses, 5 min

stops.name: Hakone Ropeway Togendai → Owakudani
stops.plan: First car up via Ubako; Fuji is clearest now (the Sounzan side is closed 7–24 Dec, this side runs)

stops.name: Owakudani black eggs
stops.plan: Steaming sulphur vents, Fuji over the ridge, black eggs for the group (+7 years each)
stops.transport: Walk to the ropeway station, 3 min

stops.name: Hakone Ropeway Owakudani → Togendai
stops.plan: Back down over the valley to the lake
stops.transport: Walk to the Togendai pier, 5 min

stops.name: Pirate ship Togendai → Moto-Hakone
stops.plan: Top deck for Fuji and the red torii from the water
stops.transport: Walk along the lakeshore to Hakone Shrine, 5 min

stops.name: Hakone Shrine & lakeside Torii of Peace
stops.plan: Cedar-lined steps up to the shrine; shoot the torii from the side path instead of the long queue
stops.transport: Walk back to Moto-Hakone port, 12 min

stops.name: Ashinoko Chaya
stops.plan: Clay-pot rice and side-dish buffet over Lake Ashi
stops.transport: Hakone Tozan bus Moto-Hakone → Kowakien (Freepass), about 35 min

stops.name: Yunessun wine, sake and coffee baths
stops.plan: Swimsuits on: the renewed wine bath, the Nihonsakari sake bath and the coffee bath; show the Freepass for the discount (no tattoos)
stops.transport: Hakone Tozan bus Kowakien → Hakone Glass no Mori (Freepass), about 30 min

stops.name: Hakone Glass no Mori Christmas crystal illumination
stops.plan: In by 17:00 for the crystal glass lights at dusk and the Christmas candles

stops.name: Hakone Sushi
stops.plan: Tatami room booked for 8: chirashi, uni-ikura bowls and anago, sake
stops.transport: Walk to Snack Takachan by the Sengoku bus stop, about 15 min

stops.name: Snack Takachan & Maron
stops.plan: Mama-san snack bar karaoke for the 8 of you; ask for a set price when booking
stops.transport: Taxi to the villa (2 cars, booked ahead or the bar's lift), 6 min

stops.name: Hot Spring Hakone Villa
stops.plan: Last soak in the villa onsen; check-out is 10:00
